Hi Alex / Clearvale legal team,

Following our commercial term sheet, attached is our proposed set of redlines to the Master Services Agreement and the Order Form focused on product-rights clarity and training/feedback licensing. Short summary:
- Output ownership: we propose customer retains proprietary rights in customer-provided content and final outputs that are a direct transformation of that content. Redwood requests a limited license for service improvement as described below.
- Training & feedback: Redwood requests an opt-in feedback license for model improvements, with strong data handling safeguards and the ability for customers to opt out per environment.
- Attribution and downstream productization: customer asks for limits on Redwood using outputs for commercial models; we propose a mutual limited license with restrictions and auditability.

Can you review the attached redlined MSA and call out any clauses you won’t accept (particularly Assignment/Ownership allocation and the proposed feedback license)? If you can indicate which items need legal justification vs commercial negotiation, that will help Ben and I triage.

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the redlines and the clear summary. I attached a redlined MSA with our counter-comments. High level concerns:
- Assignment / Title: Clearvale cannot agree to an assignment of output title to Redwood. We can consider a limited, non-exclusive license to use anonymized outputs for internal model evaluation but only if there are deletion and audit controls.
- Feedback license: We are uncomfortable with an opt-out model for training; we would accept a documented opt-in process per Project/Environment. Any license must exclude PII and must not permit redistribution.
- Telemetry/evidence: we need to see how telemetry and retention are handled (SOC 2 evidence requested). Please provide your data retention and telemetry sub-processes or an evidence packet.

We propose alternate language in Section 4.2 (Output Rights) and a tight Appendix A for Feedback & Training that limits use to aggregate, de-identified data and requires prior written consent for any commercial model training.

See attachments: Clearvale_MSA_Redlines_v1_redlined.docx (inline comments)

If Redwood can produce a short proposed Appendix A that matches our constraints, we can move faster. Also copy Procurement at procurement@clearvale.com for Order Form timing.
